patterns: authorize → validate → plan → draft → human disposition

ownership.healthy_or_done_condition: The event has exactly one reconstructable draft outcome or a visible terminal failure, cancellation, or abstention; no external side effect occurred.
ownership.owned_object: one versioned inbound event and its private draft disposition
ownership.responsibility: Produce one authorized, evidence-grounded private triage draft without taking the final disposition.
stop_approval_escalation_boundary: stop on authorization, validation, telemetry, deadline, conflict, or kill-switch failure
abstain on unsupported or contradictory evidence
route sensitive matches to the named owner
leave every final disposition to Anushrut Gupta outside this no-write adapter
verification_evidence: exact source version and UTF-8 byte evidence spans
redacted transition, plan, retry, and outcome telemetry
frozen evaluation metrics and adversarial regression results

actions: review permissions, approvals, threat model, failure matrix, and runbook
keep the adapter no-write until a separately reviewed T2 contract exists
retest after every permission, policy, runtime, dependency, model, adapter, or incident change
use the owner-controlled kill switch and evidence-bound reconciliation procedure
operate_safely.exit_condition: Operators can identify authorization, approval, monitoring, recovery, escalation, and stop boundaries without inferring them from prompt text.
operate_safely.goal: Understand the controls required before adapting the playbook to live systems.

actions: run all repository and tutorial tests
run the frozen evaluation and inspect raw numerators and denominators
exercise serial, concurrent, reordered, failed, cancelled, and recovered cases
run_repeatedly.exit_condition: All frozen tests and zero-failure invariants pass repeatedly.
run_repeatedly.goal: Prove replay, ordering, recovery, and evaluation behavior are repeatable.

actions: install the locked environment with uv sync --frozen
run the supplied synthetic fixture through the local adapter
confirm outputs remain drafts with exact evidence and no side effects
try_it.exit_condition: The sample run finishes with deterministic drafts and no external action.
try_it.goal: Run the deterministic pilot once on synthetic events and inspect private drafts.

risk.audience: authorized local operator and named human disposition owner
risk.data_class: synthetic inbound text; the reference contract treats live inbound text as confidential
risk.rationale: Bounded current-policy-authorized synthetic reads produce private drafts only; no network, external destination, write, send, or final disposition exists.
